LANDING.HERO_DESCRIPTION: TestAPK is a secure, self-hosted mobile app distribution platform that allows developers to manage, distribute, and test Android application packages (APKs) using their own Google Drive storage. Testers can install the companion mobile app on their Android devices to browse, download, and install beta releases directly from their phone.
LANDING.WEB_DASHBOARD_DESC: The central management console for your application releases, team members, and storage configurations.
LANDING.DRIVE_STORAGE_DESC: Connects directly to your personal Google Drive for secure APK storage.
LANDING.TEAM_MGMT_DESC: Invite developers to publish releases and testers to download builds.
LANDING.RELEASE_HISTORY_DESC: Track version codes, build numbers, SHA-256 hashes, and permissions.
LANDING.FLUTTER_CLIENT_DESC: The mobile application designed for testers and developers to easily install and test new releases.
LANDING.GLASSMORPHIC_UI_DESC: A premium, modern, and responsive iOS-inspired design.
LANDING.ONE_TAP_INSTALL_DESC: Download and automatically install APKs directly from the app.
LANDING.VERSION_DETECTION_DESC: Automatically compares installed versions with the latest release.
LANDING.CLI_TOOL_DESC: A powerful command-line interface for automating release uploads directly from your CI/CD pipelines.
LANDING.DEVICE_AUTH_FLOW_DESC: Securely log in using the standard OAuth Device Authorization Flow.
LANDING.REAL_TIME_PROGRESS_DESC: Visual progress bar and percentage indicator during uploads.
LANDING.DRIVE_UPLOAD_STATUS_DESC: Real-time feedback while the server transfers the APK to Google Drive.
LANDING.OAUTH_DISCLOSURE_DESC: TestAPK integrates with Google OAuth and Google Drive to provide a secure, self-hosted storage solution for your Android application packages (APKs). Here is exactly how and why we request these permissions:
LANDING.GOOGLE_SIGN_IN_DESC: We use Google Sign-In to authenticate developers and link their accounts. We only access your basic profile information (name, email, and profile picture) to personalize your dashboard.
LANDING.GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_DESC: We request the drive.file scope to create a dedicated folder named TestAPK_Releases in your Google Drive. We only read, write, and delete files that are created or uploaded through TestAPK. We cannot access any other files in your Google Drive.
LANDING.YOUR_DATA_CONTROL_DESC: All APK files are stored directly in your own Google Drive account. TestAPK does not host your files on its own servers. You can disconnect your Google Drive integration or revoke access at any time.
LANDING.PURPOSE_DESC_1: TestAPK is designed to simplify and secure the mobile application testing lifecycle for Android developers and QA teams. The primary purpose of the application is to provide a self-hosted, private distribution channel for beta APKs, eliminating the need for expensive third-party hosting services.
LANDING.PURPOSE_DESC_2: By connecting their own Google Drive accounts, developers can securely upload, version, and manage their APK releases. Testers can then access these authorized builds directly through the TestAPK web portal or the companion mobile app, ensuring a seamless and controlled testing environment.
LANDING.ABOUT_APP_DESC: TestAPK is a premium APK release management platform. The companion mobile app allows testers to get instant notifications of new builds, view release notes, and install updates with a single tap.
LANDING.SHA_256_VERIFIED_DESC: All APKs are automatically scanned and verified using SHA-256 checksums to ensure they haven't been tampered with.
LANDING.SECURE_DELIVERY_DESC: APKs are stored securely in Google Drive and delivered via encrypted HTTPS connections.

ABOUT.TITLE: About TestAPK
ABOUT.SUBTITLE: A secure, self-hosted mobile app distribution platform
ABOUT.SUPPORT_CHANNELS_DESC: You can also reach out to us directly through any of the following channels:
ABOUT.FOOTER: TestAPK © 2026. Built with React, Node.js, and Flutter.
ABOUT.MISSION_DESC: TestAPK was built to give developers complete control over their mobile application distribution pipeline. By leveraging personal Google Drive storage, we eliminate the reliance on third-party hosting services, ensuring your proprietary code and data remain entirely under your control.
ABOUT.HOW_IT_WORKS_STEP_1_DESC: Authenticate securely with Google OAuth and authorize TestAPK to create a dedicated folder in your Google Drive.
ABOUT.HOW_IT_WORKS_STEP_2_DESC: Upload your Android application packages (APKs) via the web dashboard or automate it directly from your CI/CD pipeline using our CLI tool.
ABOUT.HOW_IT_WORKS_STEP_3_DESC: Add team members as Developers (to upload builds) or Testers (to download and test builds).
ABOUT.HOW_IT_WORKS_STEP_4_DESC: Testers use the premium companion mobile app to receive notifications, view release notes, and install updates with a single tap.
ABOUT.SECURITY_DESC_1: We believe in absolute transparency. TestAPK does not store your APK files on our servers. When you upload a release, it is streamed directly to your Google Drive.
ABOUT.SECURITY_DESC_2: Furthermore, we compute SHA-256 checksums for every upload to guarantee package integrity, and all communications are encrypted using industry-standard TLS protocols.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.INTRO_CONTENT: Welcome to TestAPK. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our web dashboard, mobile application, and command line interface (CLI).
PRIVACY.ACCOUNT_INFO: Account Information: When you sign in using Google OAuth, we receive your name, email address, and profile picture.
PRIVACY.DRIVE_INTEGRATION: Google Drive Integration: To enable APK storage and management, our application requests permission to access your Google Drive. We only access, create, and modify files that are created by or uploaded through the TestAPK application (using the drive.file scope). We do not access or read any other files in your Google Drive.
PRIVACY.APP_METADATA: Application Metadata: We collect metadata about the APK files you upload (such as package name, version code, version name, and release notes) to display them in your dashboard and mobile app.
PRIVACY.USE_LIST: To authenticate your identity and manage your account.;To facilitate the upload, storage, and retrieval of APK files directly to/from your own Google Drive storage.;To display application release history and details on your dashboard and mobile client.;To support the CLI tool's authentication and upload flows.
PRIVACY.SHARING_CONTENT: We do not sell, trade, or share your personal data or Google Drive files with third parties. All APK files are stored directly in your own Google Drive account. The TestAPK server only stores metadata (such as file IDs, version numbers, and release notes) to coordinate downloads and installations.
PRIVACY.SECURITY_CONTENT: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your account metadata and authentication tokens. Your Google OAuth tokens are transmitted securely and stored using encryption.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_CONTENT: You have full control over your data:;You can disconnect your Google Drive integration at any time through the dashboard settings.;You can revoke TestAPK's access to your Google Account entirely by visiting the Google Account Permissions page.;You can request the deletion of your TestAPK account and associated metadata by contacting us.
PRIVACY.CONTACT_CONTENT: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.ANSWER_1: TestAPK is a modern, secure, and self-hosted APK release management platform that allows developers to distribute beta builds directly to testers.
FAQ.ANSWER_2: You can download and install the latest APK releases directly from the app list. Make sure to allow installation from unknown sources if prompted.
FAQ.QUESTION_3: Where are the APK files stored?
FAQ.ANSWER_3: All APK files are securely stored in the developer's Google Drive, ensuring full control and ownership of the data.
FAQ.QUESTION_4: How do I get access to an app?
FAQ.ANSWER_4: You must be invited by the app owner or developer as a tester. Once invited, you will receive an invitation in the app list to accept.
FAQ.ANSWER_5: Yes, TestAPK uses Google OAuth for secure authentication and does not access any files in your Google Drive other than those created by the app.
FAQ.QUESTION_6: Where do I upload the APK?
FAQ.ANSWER_6: You can upload APKs via the web dashboard at https://testapk.clipboux.online/ or by using the TestAPK CLI tool.
FAQ.QUESTION_7: How do I connect my Google Drive?
FAQ.ANSWER_7: Go to your dashboard, click on 'Configure Drive', and authorize TestAPK. TestAPK will only create and manage its own folder (TestAPK_Releases) to store your APKs.
FAQ.QUESTION_8: How do I upload a new release?
FAQ.ANSWER_8: You can upload a release directly from the web dashboard by clicking 'New Release' and selecting your APK file, or automatically using the TestAPK CLI tool.
FAQ.QUESTION_9: How do I use the CLI tool to upload builds?
FAQ.ANSWER_9: Install the CLI via npm (npm install -g testapk-cli), authenticate using the device flow (testapk login), and upload using testapk upload <path-to-apk>.
FAQ.QUESTION_10: How do I invite testers or developers?
FAQ.ANSWER_10: In the dashboard, select your app, go to the 'Team' tab, and add the email addresses of your testers or developers. Testers will receive an invitation in their companion app.
FAQ.QUESTION_11: Does TestAPK store my APK files?
FAQ.ANSWER_11: No, TestAPK does not store your APK files on its servers. All files are streamed directly to and stored in your own Google Drive.
